purpose: Find failures, test one public-action adaptation without weakening existing proof gates
promotion_gates: All existing tests and new physical-rank/proof-wrapper tests pass
Zero illegal replies, accounting errors or trust loss in every match
Exact original initial certified floor remains protected
Fresh holdout paired comparison, reporting all profiles, losses and worst result
At least baseline match wins, greater total net, and no worse worst match on holdout
Clock-enabled supplied engine and external raw resource timing if holdout gates pass
limitations: One development trial and fixed small holdout, not equilibrium, universal nonloss or tournament odds. Failed gates mean do not promote. Freeze original v1 and its attestation. No duplicate inference, hidden-card inputs, grace-window exploitation or runtime file/network/process access.
